Monolith vs Microservices: storyboard

Episode 2 · voice Laura · 12 scenes · 82.2s (measured timing) · one still per beat, 8 frames after it fires

hook hook FlowDiagram · 0.0s–6.1s

Headline: One box. Forever?

“Monoliths aren't bad. They just don't scale forever. So why does everyone split them up?”

branding sting 6.1s–7.6s

Bite wipe → logos → cut. No voiceover, just the chomp.

idea idea Analogy · 7.6s–14.5s

Headline: Kitchen or food court?

“A monolith is one big kitchen cooking everything. Microservices? A food court: one dish per stall.”

breakdown mono FlowDiagram · 14.5s–21.8s

No headline

“One monolith: users, payments and search share one codebase, one database. Easy to build, easy to ship.”

breakdown monobug FlowDiagram · 21.8s–28.1s

Headline: One bug, all down

“Until one bug in search takes the whole app down. And every tiny change means redeploying everything.”

breakdown split ThreeCards · 28.1s–34.0s

Headline: One job each

“Microservices cut it up. Each service does one job, owns its data, and ships alone.”

breakdown isolate Split · 34.0s–41.4s

Headline: Fail alone

“Payments crashes? The monolith goes down with it. Microservices? Users and search keep serving.”

breakdown comms Sequence · 41.4s–49.2s

No headline

“The catch: services talk over the network. Checkout calls payments, payments calls the bank, and any hop can time out.”

breakdown dial Tiers · 49.2s–57.2s

Headline: Pick your trade-off

“It's a dial. Monolith: simple, but it all moves as one. Microservices scale apart, but there's more to run.”

breakdown examples Analogy · 57.2s–64.6s

Headline: Big names, both ways

“Amazon began as a monolith, then split into thousands of services. Shopify still runs one, kept tidy.”

breakdown when Decision · 64.6s–71.7s

Headline: Time to split?

“When to split? Is it really hurting? Is there a clean piece to cut? Split it out. If not, stay whole.”

breakdown bigpicture BigPicture · 71.7s–77.6s

No headline

“Put it together: one box fails together, services fail alone, but every call pays a hop.”

gist gist GistCard · 77.6s–82.2s

No headline

“That's the gist: start whole, split when it hurts. Follow for more.”
